reviews.name: Fadil Kryezi
reviews.text:
Ich bin hier in der Nähe von Freiburg in der Rehaklinik und heute mit meinem Freund zusammen waren wir in der Moschee zum Freitags gebet es war sehr beeindruckend, wir in der Hof von Moschee angekommen waren sind wir sehr herzlich begrüßt worden von freundlichen jungen Männern, dann der Hoxha einfach einzigartig Stimme beim Kuran lesen sein predigt war einfach sehr rührend und auf dem Punkt gebracht, bei dem Verabschiedung unbekannt eine Herr begrüßt uns und führte uns zu anderen Räume des Moschee. Eine vorbildliche Gesellschaft.
Danke dass wir so eine tolle Tag hatten dürfen.
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm currently in rehab near Freiburg, and today my boyfriend and I went to the mosque for Friday prayers. It was very impressive. When we arrived at the mosque courtyard, we were warmly greeted by friendly young men. Then the Hoxha (religious leader) had a truly unique voice while reading the Quran. His sermon was incredibly moving and perfectly to the point. As we were leaving, a gentleman, whom we didn't know, greeted us and led us to other parts of the mosque. A truly exemplary group.

Thank you for allowing us to have such a wonderful day.

reviews.name: DIR AR
reviews.text:
اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

﴿ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنْفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنْ رَبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰ ﴾
صدق الله العظيم

عندما يطرد نسل الأنبياء و أولياء الله من مساجد الله فقط لأن شخص ما ظنّ بهم السوء فأعلم بأن الرحمن لن يسامحكم و لن اسامحكم أنا أيضاً أمام الرحمن
reviews.textTranslated:
I seek refuge in God from Satan, the accursed.

In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

"They follow nothing but conjecture and what their souls desire, while guidance has already come to them from their Lord." (Quran 53:12)

God Almighty has spoken the truth.

When the descendants of the prophets and the righteous are expelled from the mosques of God simply because someone harbored ill thoughts about them, know that the Most Merciful will not forgive you, and I, too, will not forgive you before the Most Merciful.
